answer: The wander schedule is applied in horizon and trellis publishes each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 32% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3715 identities would post 2922 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
